1_raw_input_from_lpudata.title: NOTICE (1/1/2011)
1_raw_input_from_lpudata.body: • The students can now view their marks of End Term Examinations (December, 2010) on UMS. • Scrutiny is scheduled on 4th January, 2011. The students are required to follow the below mentioned instructions for Scrutiny: - 1. Students are required to sit according to the Roll No. in the assigned room already displayed in the UMS for scrutiny on dated 04-01-2011. 2. Students have to use only LEAD PENCILONLY during the scrutiny, if any student found with any sort of pen during the scrutiny it will be a case of UMC. 3. Students are required to check their answer sheets of all the courses in a stipulated time of 30 MINUTES ONLY during the scrutiny. 4. During Scrutiny students can write (a) Totaling is wrong. (b) A particular Question is unchecked. (c) Part of a particular Question is unchecked. kind of comments in the column provided in the answer sheets: 5. After scrutiny students have to return back all the answer sheets to the invigilator after writing comments in the space provided in the answer sheet if any rectification is there in any course. 6. If a student is not satisfied with the evaluation of a particular course then they have to apply for re-evaluation which is a different process. Regarding re-evaluation students have to consult the Examination Department. 7. For students who have been also appeared for backlog courses, scrutiny is scheduled in room no 28-101 between 11:00-2:00. 8. Students are not allowed to keep their bags, mobiles and other belongings with them during Scrutiny. For any further clarification you may contact Dr. Ramesh Thakur, COD-F (Chemistry) Division of Examination Authorized By: Dr. Lovi Raj Gupta Sr. Dean (LFTS)
